item: הנהו X (plural of ההוא X), e.g. הנהו בריוני
note: Bavli: [Gittin 56a:10](sefaria:Gittin.56a.10) (27 segments). Gazetteer: “certain zealots”. Plural counterpart of ההוא X; not in the Individuals or Groups lists or fn 94. Count is for persons only (הנהו גברי/רבנן/בריוני/בני/תרי/אינשי/דבי).

item: הרוגי לוד (also הרוגי מלכות, הרוגי ביתר)
note: Bavli: [Bava_Batra 10b:6](sefaria:Bava_Batra.10b.6) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “the martyrs of Lod”. Group named by toponym. The Gemara identifies the anonymous הרוגי מלכות as הרוגי לוד (BB 10b:6, Pesachim 50a:8); Taanit 18b:8 names them לולינוס ופפוס (לוליאנוס is in the paper as a given name).

item: גדולי X (גדולי גליל / גדולי רומי / גדולי הדור)
note: Bavli: [Chullin 106a:6](sefaria:Chullin.106a.6) (30 segments). Gazetteer: “the great men of the Galilee”. New group pattern. Gazetteer also has 'the prominent men of Rome' (Rosh Hashanah 19a:5) and 'the great men of the generation' (Bava Batra 36b:3-4).
Bavli: [Bava_Metzia 49b:6](sefaria:Bava_Metzia.49b.6) (3 segments). Gazetteer: “the merchants of Lod”. Occupation + toponym group (cf. דייני X). Also Moed Katan 13b:6 (תגרי טבריא).
Bavli: [Moed_Katan 13b:6](sefaria:Moed_Katan.13b.6) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “The hunters of Akko”. Same baraita as תגרי טבריא and דשושי ציפורי; occupation + toponym.
Bavli: [Moed_Katan 13b:6](sefaria:Moed_Katan.13b.6) (1 segments). Gazetteer: “The groats makers of Tzippori”. Same baraita; occupation + toponym.

Bavli: [Sanhedrin 43a:10](sefaria:Sanhedrin.43a.10) (2 segments). Gazetteer: “The prominent women of Jerusalem”. Pattern 'X שבירושלים'. Related, not in gazetteer: נקיי הדעת שבירושלים (3 hits, Gittin 87b:12), also not in paper.

Bavli: [Ketubot 50a:12](sefaria:Ketubot.50a.12) (7 segments). Gazetteer: “The rabbis in Yavne”. Unidentified group: 'דרשו רבותינו שביבנה' (Ketubot 50a:12), 'רבותינו שבדרום' (Eruvin 65b:18). The Groups list has רבנן דX but not רבותינו שבX; the identification list has only the Sanhedrin 17b items (רבותינו שבבבל, שבארץ ישראל).
